world.title: Lunate launches its first sharia-compliant, dividend-paying ETF
world.description: Lunate, the Abu Dhabi-based investment manager, said its first GCC sharia-compliant, dividend-paying exchange-traded fund is due to list on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange on June 23. The ETF will track the Solactive GCC shariah dividend index, which comprises dividend-paying, sharia-compliant equities from across the Gulf Cooperation Council. world.title: Turkey strikes natural gas supply deal with Azerbaijan
